claims.question: q3
claims.claim: RADAR is a multi-stage review funnel that classifies diffs by authorship and source type, applies eligibility gates, static heuristics, a machine-learned Diff Risk Score, LLM-based automated review, and deterministic validation before landing.
claims.quote: We deployed RADAR (Risk Aware Diff Auto Review), a multi-stage funnel that classifies each diff by authorship and source type, applies eligibility gates, static heuristics, a machine-learned Diff Risk Score, LLM-based Automated Code Review, and deterministic validation before landing qualifying changes.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Relaxing the Diff Risk Score threshold from the 25th to the 50th percentile increased the approve rate to 60.31%.
claims.quote: Relaxing the Diff Risk Score threshold from the 25th to the 50th percentile increased the approve rate to 60.31%.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: RADAR reduced median time to close by over 330% and median diff review wall time by 35%.
claims.quote: RADAR reduces median time to close by over 330% and median diff review wall time by 35%.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: RADAR-reviewed diffs had a revert rate one-third that of non-RADAR diffs and a Production Incident rate one-fiftieth that of non-RADAR diffs.
claims.quote: The revert rate for RADAR-reviewed diffs is 1/3 that of non-RADAR diffs, and the Production Incident rate is 1/50 that of non-RADAR diffs.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: The paper claims risk-aware layered automation can materially reduce review bottlenecks caused by AI-driven code growth without compromising production safety.
